name: Tidepool Finery
flavor: Worn to the Tidepool Finery, where everyone arrives a little damp and nobody minds.

three.text: Its first Steam each fight cannot be reflected.

name: Forge-Warm Kit
flavor: The kit the forge-folk pack for the long cold walk home.

three.text: Crits after a Wildfire deal +20 pt crit damage for a round.

name: Hollow Weave
flavor: Woven one strand at a time in the Hollow, and it takes all three to hold.

three.text: Heals 3% of max HP whenever it cashes Grounding.

name: Ridge Copper
flavor: Copper from the Ridge, drawn into thread, glass and bead.

three.text: Overload also leaves Charged afterwards, so a chain can follow.

name: Warden's Watch
flavor: The night watch's own kit. It asks a Guard to stand a little wider.

three.text: Protects one more creature on each side of it.

name: Hearth Helpers
flavor: The kit of the one who makes sure everyone is warm, fed and within reach.

three.text: Its boost also lands on the creature two slots away.

name: First Footprints
flavor: Whoever leaves the first mark is the one the others follow.

three.text: Its first mark each fight cannot be replaced.

name: Pounce Set
flavor: For the creature that waits for the mark, and then does not wait at all.

three.text: Its first reaction each fight crits.

name: Crossroads Wanderer
flavor: Worn by those who take the fifth road at the Old Crossroads.

three.text: One more hour of finds on 24 hour trips.

name: Lantern Night
flavor: The Festival pieces together: hearth, lantern and cap, lit once a season.

three.text: Guards in its row: their abilities last 1 more round.
